posts.caption: £7 for a coffee. I hope it comes with financial advice.
posts.translationZh: 一杯咖啡要 7 英鎊。希望還附贈理財建議。
posts.imageAlt: Zoe reacting to the price of takeaway coffee in a cozy London café beside a rainy window and card terminal.

posts.caption: We planned a picnic. The clouds clearly had other plans.
posts.translationZh: 我們原本計畫野餐。看來雲另有安排。
posts.imageAlt: Bella at a cloudy park picnic with sandwiches, fruit and a blanket as rain starts.

posts.caption: Found a tiny bakery with the best croissant I've had in ages.
posts.translationZh: 找到一家小小的麵包店，吃到我很久以來最棒的可頌。
posts.imageAlt: Hugo admiring a flaky croissant at a tiny bakery table beside an espresso.

posts.caption: I promised myself I wouldn't touch my keyboard again. Anyway, here's a new switch.
posts.translationZh: 我答應自己不再亂改鍵盤。總之，這是新買的軸體。
posts.imageAlt: Theo inspecting a keyboard switch next to his compact mechanical keyboard at home.

posts.caption: Rainy morning, warm tea, and absolutely no plans. Perfect.
posts.translationZh: 下雨的早晨、熱茶，完全沒有行程。完美。
posts.imageAlt: Yuna sitting by a rain-streaked window with tea and a small green houseplant.

posts.caption: Bought a coffee machine. This is either a smart move or a very expensive hobby.
posts.translationZh: 買了一台咖啡機。不知道是明智投資，還是昂貴的新嗜好。
posts.imageAlt: Zoe unpacking a home espresso machine on her cluttered kitchen counter beside a mug and instruction booklet.
posts.storyContext: £7 for a coffee. I hope it comes with financial advice.

posts.caption: Moved the picnic indoors. Apparently my living room is now a park.
posts.translationZh: 野餐改在室內。看來我家客廳現在成了公園。
posts.imageAlt: Bella enjoying an indoor picnic with sandwiches and grapes in her cozy apartment.
posts.storyContext: We planned a picnic. The clouds clearly had other plans.

posts.caption: Tried baking one myself. The dough looked confident. I did not.
posts.translationZh: 試著自己烤可頌。麵團看起來很有自信，我沒有。
posts.imageAlt: Hugo shaping croissant dough on a flour-dusted kitchen counter.
posts.storyContext: Found a tiny bakery with the best croissant I've had in ages.

posts.caption: One switch turned into a full rebuild. How did that happen?
posts.translationZh: 原本只換一顆軸體，最後整把重裝。怎麼會這樣？
posts.imageAlt: Theo beside his disassembled compact keyboard with keycaps and tools spread across the same desk.
posts.storyContext: I promised myself I wouldn't touch my keyboard again. Anyway, here's a new switch.

posts.caption: A little sun finally found its way into my room.
posts.translationZh: 陽光終於偷偷照進我的房間了。
posts.imageAlt: Yuna watching sunshine return to her windowsill, next to her familiar tea mug and potted plant.
posts.storyContext: Rainy morning, warm tea, and absolutely no plans. Perfect.

posts.caption: I went looking for a small puzzle. Somehow it took over my whole afternoon.
posts.translationZh: 我本來只想找個小謎題，結果整個下午都被它占滿了。
posts.imageAlt: Ada browsing a wooden puzzle box at an outdoor flea market.

posts.caption: I stopped for one scoop. The second scoop made a very convincing argument.
posts.translationZh: 我本來只想吃一球。第二球的理由實在太有說服力。
posts.imageAlt: Bella enjoying an ice cream cone outside a neighborhood ice cream shop.

posts.caption: I came for coffee and ended up negotiating with a chessboard.
posts.translationZh: 我本來是來喝咖啡的，結果開始跟棋盤談判。
posts.imageAlt: Felix focused on an outdoor chess game at a cafe table.

posts.caption: One more try, I told myself. My arms would like to file a complaint.
posts.translationZh: 我跟自己說再試一次。我的手臂想提出正式抗議。
posts.imageAlt: Finn taking a breather at an outdoor bouldering wall after a climb.

posts.caption: I couldn’t pronounce the snack, so I pointed. Excellent decision.
posts.translationZh: 我不會唸那個小吃的名字，就直接用手指。結果非常正確。
posts.imageAlt: Hugo sampling a street-food snack at a lively market stall.

posts.caption: The movie was good. The courtyard conversation afterward was even better.
posts.translationZh: 電影很好看。散場後在庭院的聊天更精彩。
posts.imageAlt: Iris watching an outdoor film screening in a courtyard.

posts.caption: I brought a notebook to the river. The river did most of the writing.
posts.translationZh: 我帶了筆記本到河邊，結果大部分內容都是河流寫的。
posts.imageAlt: Isla writing in her journal beside a riverside path.

posts.caption: I went up to find one star and came back with a list of questions.
posts.translationZh: 我上屋頂本來只想找一顆星，最後帶著一串問題回來。
posts.imageAlt: Luna looking through a telescope during rooftop stargazing.

posts.caption: The lake looked calm. Getting back on the board was a different chapter.
posts.translationZh: 湖面看起來很平靜。重新站回板上又是另一回事。
posts.imageAlt: Max enjoying a paddleboard outing on a calm lake.

posts.caption: I stopped for one mural and somehow met the whole neighborhood.
posts.translationZh: 我本來只停下來看一幅壁畫，結果像認識了整個街區。
posts.imageAlt: Maya admiring a colorful mural in her neighborhood.

posts.caption: The bus was late. At least the playlist understood the assignment.
posts.translationZh: 公車晚到了，至少播放清單很懂今天的狀況。
posts.imageAlt: Noah listening to music while waiting at a rainy bus stop.

posts.caption: Laundry update: one sock missing, and absolutely no leads.
posts.translationZh: 洗衣進度：少了一隻襪子，目前完全沒有線索。
posts.imageAlt: Oscar checking a mismatched sock at a laundromat.

posts.caption: The table is standing. The extra screw and I are choosing not to panic.
posts.translationZh: 桌子已經站起來了。我和多出來的螺絲決定先不慌。
posts.imageAlt: Ryan assembling a flat-pack table and noticing an extra screw.

posts.caption: I went to browse. Now I have strong opinions about desk sculptures.
posts.translationZh: 我本來只是逛逛，現在對桌上雕塑有很多意見。
posts.imageAlt: Theo browsing a small design market and inspecting a desk sculpture.

posts.caption: I came in for one flower. The bouquet had other plans.
posts.translationZh: 我本來只想買一朵花，花束顯然另有安排。
posts.imageAlt: Yuna choosing flowers at a neighborhood flower shop.

posts.caption: I went in to return one book and left with three. A very reliable system.
posts.translationZh: 我本來是去還一本書，最後帶了三本離開。這套流程真可靠。
posts.imageAlt: Zoe browsing a bookshop and leaving with a small stack of books.

posts.caption: The machine won. My kitchen is covered in milk.
posts.translationZh: 我輸給咖啡機了。廚房到處都是牛奶。
posts.imageAlt: Zoe reacting to frothy milk spilled around the espresso machine on the same kitchen counter.
posts.storyContext: £7 for a coffee. I hope it comes with financial advice. Bought a coffee machine. This is either a smart move or a very expensive hobby.

posts.caption: Last night turned into a board-game war. Nobody is speaking to the dice.
posts.translationZh: 昨晚變成桌遊大戰。現在沒人想跟骰子說話。
posts.imageAlt: Bella after a board-game night with dice, pieces and snack bowls scattered across the living room floor.
posts.storyContext: We planned a picnic. The clouds clearly had other plans. Moved the picnic indoors. Apparently my living room is now a park.

posts.caption: Update: they're not croissants. They're crunchy little mistakes.
posts.translationZh: 最新消息：這些不是可頌，是一顆顆酥脆的小失誤。
posts.imageAlt: Hugo beside his uneven, overly browned homemade croissants on a kitchen baking tray.
posts.storyContext: Found a tiny bakery with the best croissant I've had in ages. Tried baking one myself. The dough looked confident. I did not.

posts.caption: Finished the keyboard. It sounds amazing. It's also 2 a.m.
posts.translationZh: 鍵盤總算組好了。聲音超好聽。現在也凌晨兩點了。
posts.imageAlt: Theo beside his finished compact keyboard late at night, with a desk lamp and analog clock.
posts.storyContext: I promised myself I wouldn't touch my keyboard again. Anyway, here's a new switch. One switch turned into a full rebuild. How did that happen?

posts.caption: My plant has a new leaf. I know it's small, but look at it.
posts.translationZh: 我的植物長出新葉子了。我知道這是小事，但你看嘛。
posts.imageAlt: Yuna gently admiring the tender new leaf on her windowsill plant beside her tea mug.
posts.storyContext: Rainy morning, warm tea, and absolutely no plans. Perfect. A little sun finally found its way into my room.
